description: This file contains a utility function 'get_api_base' that determines the API base URL for a given language model, based on provided parameters, model aliases, and provider logic. It handles different provider types and special cases for Google Vertex AI, Gemini, and OpenAI.

methods.name: get_api_base
methods.description: Determines and returns the API base URL for a specified model and parameters, considering provider logic, model aliases, and special cases for Google Vertex AI, Gemini, and OpenAI.
